ocl:
context Customer
inv: (self.address <> null) and (self.fullName <> '' and self.fullName.size() > 0)

context Customer
inv: (self.cards->any(x | x.limit <= 50) <> null) and (self.address <> null)

context Loan
inv: (if self.principal > self.interestRate then self.principal else self.interestRate endif > 45) and (self.customer.oclIsTypeOf(Customer))

context CheckingAccount
inv: self.overdraftLimit >= 19 and self.overdraftLimit <= 31

context Account
inv: self.transactions->size() >= 1 and self.transactions->size() <= 2

context Address
inv: self.city <> null and self.line1 <> null

context Address
inv: self.country <> null implies self.line1 <> null

context Address
inv: self.line1 <> null and self.city <> null

context Address
inv: self.line1 <> null implies self.country <> null

context Address
inv: self.line1 <> null implies self.city <> null

context CreditCard
inv: ((self.limit <= 10) and (self.cardTransactions->forAll(v | v.merchant <> ''))) and (self.limit > 10)

context Address
inv: (self.country <> null and self.line1 <> null) and (not(self.country <> null and self.line1 <> null))

context Account
inv: ((self.balance >= 5) and (self.transactions->forAll(v | v.amount <= 1000))) and (self.balance < 5)

context Account
inv: ((self.transactions->size() <= 3) and (self.balance >= 74 and self.balance <= 94)) and (self.transactions->size() > 3)

context Loan
inv: (self.interestRate = self.principal) and (not(self.interestRate = self.principal))

context Branch
inv: ((self.customers->collect(x | x.customerId)->notEmpty()) and (self.city <> null)) and (not((self.customers->collect(x | x.customerId)->notEmpty()) and (self.city <> null)))

context Account
inv: ((self.balance <= 100) and (self.transactions->forAll(v | v.amount >= 2))) and (self.balance > 100)

context Branch
inv: ((self.bank.swiftCode <> '') and (self.customers->collect(x | x.fullName)->notEmpty())) and (not((self.bank.swiftCode <> '') and (self.customers->collect(x | x.fullName)->notEmpty())))

context Account
inv: ((self.transactions->any(x | x.amount > 2) <> null) and (self.transactions->size() >= 1 and self.transactions->size() <= 2)) and (self.transactions->size() < 1)

context Account
inv: ((self.customer.branch.city <> '') and (self.accountNo.indexOf('test') >= 0)) and (not((self.customer.branch.city <> '') and (self.accountNo.indexOf('test') >= 0)))

context Address
inv: (self.city <> null implies self.line1 <> null) and (not(self.city <> null implies self.line1 <> null))

context Customer
inv: (self.address <> null) and (not(self.address <> null))

context Loan
inv: ((self.principal > 0) and (if self.interestRate > self.principal then self.interestRate else self.principal endif >= 16)) and (self.principal < -5)

context Account
inv: ((self.balance > 1) and (self.transactions->forAll(v | v.amount > 5))) and (self.balance < -4)
